candidates.note: White Center location of the on-file 'Zeeks Pizza' chain, per the chain's own location page.

candidates.name: Stoneburner
candidates.note: An Italian restaurant and bar on the ground floor of Hotel Ballard whose menu centers on housemade pasta and vegetable dishes, with a rotating seasonal wood-fired pizza (e.g. winter squash, basil, and imported white cheese) alongside it.

candidates.name: Petoskey's
candidates.note: A Fremont neighborhood sports bar with an Upper Midwest-leaning menu of hoagies, cheese curds, and beer that also serves a thin-crust "Midwest Tavern Style" pizza, available whole or by the slice.

candidates.name: Messina Modern Italian Kitchen
candidates.note: A modern Italian restaurant in Lower Queen Anne built around pasta and antipasti; its menu also includes a pizza topped with hot honey, pepperoni, and cheese.

candidates.name: Cotto Belltown
candidates.note: An Italian restaurant and bar serving house-made pasta alongside wood-fired pizzas such as the Margherita.

candidates.name: Limoncello Belltown
candidates.note: An Italian restaurant best known for house-made pasta and a limoncello cocktail that also serves pizza on its dinner menu.

candidates.name: Bombo Italian Kitchen
candidates.note: An Ethan Stowell Italian restaurant at the Washington State Convention Center whose oven-baked pizzas anchor a menu that also covers pasta, antipasto, and happy hour.

candidates.name: Von's 1000Spirits
candidates.note: A cocktail bar near Pike Place Market built around a 1,000-plus bottle spirits collection, whose food menu centers on Seattle sourdough pizzas and pastas.

candidates.name: King Street Bar & Oven
candidates.note: A sports bar near Lumen Field with a custom stone oven that turns out house-made pizza alongside calzones and sandwiches.

candidates.name: Bar Cotto
candidates.note: A Parma-style salumeria and cocktail bar from chef Ethan Stowell, built around charcuterie and bruschetta, that also serves 13-inch pizzas ($13-$16) alongside spaghetti and calzones.

candidates.name: Cora Pizza & Plates
candidates.note: An Italian restaurant from chef John Sundstrom with starters, pasta (rigatoni bolognese, spaghettini puttanesca), wood-roasted vegetables and dessert, whose 11-inch wood-fired pizzas include cheese, pepperoni, margherita, cacio e pepe, and mushroom pies.

candidates.name: Single Shot
candidates.note: A Capitol Hill bar and restaurant with a stone oven that turns out a Pizza Margherita ($12) and a Tuscan Kale flatbread alongside bites, cocktails and entrees like striped bass and pork chop.

candidates.name: Cafe Lago
candidates.note: A long-running Montlake Italian restaurant known for handmade pasta that also bakes thin-crust, apple-wood-fired pizzas (such as a goat cheese and caramelized onion pie and a classic marinara and mozzarella pie); it was an early Seattle adopter of wood-fired pizza.

candidates.name: Willmott's Ghost
candidates.note: An all-day Italian restaurant on the ground floor of Amazon's Spheres; Roman-style pizza al taglio dominates its lunch menu alongside starters, salads, and secondi like lemon ricotta lasagna.

candidates.name: Cinque Terre Ristorante
candidates.note: An Italian ristorante in Amazon's Doppler building; its stone-oven Neapolitan pizzas (margherita, calabrese, bianca) are served alongside pastas and entrees.

candidates.name: Big Time Brewery & Alehouse
candidates.note: Seattle's original brewpub, pouring its own beer since 1988; its kitchen menu includes 8-inch and 16-inch pizzas (cheese, pepperoni, Hawaiian, BBQ chicken, and more) alongside sandwiches and burgers.

candidates.name: Fiddler's Inn Pub & Pizza
candidates.note: A neighborhood pub with a patio and live music; serves 10-inch and 16-inch pub pizzas alongside sandwiches and salads.

candidates.name: Watershed Pub & Kitchen
candidates.note: A neighborhood pub in the Thornton Place development with 21 rotating beer taps, sandwiches, mac and cheese, and salads; its kitchen also turns out New York-style pizza, which reviewers single out as a highlight.

candidates.name: That's Amore Italian Cafe
candidates.note: An Italian restaurant and cafe on Mount Baker Ridge known for pasta and classic Italian fare; its menu includes a dedicated pizza section with six wood-style pies such as Margherita, Pepperoni, Roma, and Vegetali.

candidates.name: Hatback Bar & Grille
candidates.note: A sports bar and grille near the SoDo stadiums serving burgers, wings, and Pacific Northwest seafood; pizza is one of its game-day menu items alongside those dishes.

candidates.name: La Rustica
candidates.note: A long-running Italian restaurant on Beach Drive near Alki Point, open since 1996, whose menu of old-country recipes includes antipasti and handmade pasta alongside wood-fired pizzas such as an arugula pizza with prosciutto and olives.

candidates.name: Swel
candidates.note: A slightly upscale Fremont trattoria serving pastas, small plates and steaks, where the wood-fired pizzas, served with a spicy chili oil, are called out by reviewers as the kitchen's strongest dishes.

candidates.name: Trailbend Taproom
candidates.note: A Ballard craft-beer taproom with dozens of rotating taps whose kitchen runs a Wood Stone oven for wood-fired pizzas and flatbreads alongside sandwiches and salads.
